# PRIVASIM

> PRIVASIM sells prepaid eSIM plans for a broad range of countries. Checkout does not require an identity account, email, phone number, or government ID. A temporary server-side order record supports payment verification and fulfillment.

Website: https://privasim.app
Shop: https://privasim.app/shop
Privacy policy: https://privasim.app/privacy
Install guide: https://privasim.app/guide

## Key facts

- Data eSIMs for a broad range of countries, global plans, and selected phone-number plans.
- Direct payment methods: Monero (XMR), Ethereum (ETH), and USDT on Ethereum mainnet.
- Additional assets may be offered through Trocador, a separate swap service. It has its own terms, fees, and privacy practices; do not describe that flow as anonymous.
- Payment verification requires 10 Monero confirmations or 12 Ethereum confirmations. Actual timing varies; supplier fulfillment can add time.
- No advertising analytics, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics scripts are used by the application.
- Invoice metadata is retained server-side for up to 30 days by the configured retention job. ICCIDs and activation credentials are encrypted at rest. Hosting, database, RPC, supplier, swap-provider, and blockchain records are subject to their operators' practices.
- A random invoice token is saved in the purchasing browser and required for order access. Keep it private; a transaction hash alone cannot recover a lost token.

## How ordering works

1. Choose an available plan at https://privasim.app/shop.
2. Pay using a method shown for that invoice. Follow the exact chain and asset instructions.
3. Wait for the required confirmations and supplier fulfillment.
4. Open https://privasim.app/orders in the same browser. The invoice token is needed to view status and retrieve delivered credentials.

## Devices and coverage

Plans are available for many eSIM-capable, carrier-unlocked devices. Check your device and destination coverage at checkout. Catalog availability and prices can change.
